commands:
kubectl get pods -n fleetcast -o wide
kubectl get events -n fleetcast --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -35

kubectl get svc,deploy,cm,networkpolicy -n fleetcast
kubectl logs -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend --tail=70
kubectl get deployment fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -n fleetcast -o yaml

kubectl get svc -n fleetcast -o yaml
kubectl logs -n fleetcast locust-fetcher --tail=45
kubectl logs -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend --tail=25
kubectl exec -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- ls /app

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend -- cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
kubectl get ingress -n fleetcast -o yaml
kubectl exec -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- python -c 'import urllib.request; r=urllib.request.urlopen("http://fleetcast-satellite-app-backend:5000/api/dashboard",timeout=20); print(r.status,r.read())'
kubectl get pod locust-fetcher -n fleetcast -o yaml

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend -- sh -c 'ls /usr/share/nginx/html/static/js; printenv'
kubectl get all -n fleetcast
kubectl get events -n fleetcast --field-selector type=Warning
ls -la /tmp

kubectl logs -n fleetcast -l app=satellite-app-backend --tail=5000 --prefix | rg -i 'error|exception|traceback|failed|500 ' | tail -45
kubectl exec -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend -- sh -c 'grep -oE "https?[^\" ]+|.{0,80}/api/.{0,80}" /usr/share/nginx/html/static/js/main.96c884c5.js'

kubectl get secrets -n fleetcast
kubectl exec -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- python -c 'import socket,urllib.request; print(socket.gethostbyname_ex("load-generator"))' 
kubectl get deploy fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend -n fleetcast -o yaml

kubectl get secret sh.helm.release.v1.fleetcast.v1 -n fleetcast -o jsonpath='{.data.release}' | base64 -d | base64 -d | gzip -d > /tmp/fleetcast-release.json
python -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/fleetcast-release.json")); print(d["manifest"])'

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- python -c 'import urllib.request,json; base="http://fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend"; paths=["/","/api/health","/api/dashboard","/api/station/GS-1"]; [(print(p,r.status,r.headers.get("Content-Type"),len(r.read()))) for p in paths for r in [urllib.request.urlopen(base+p,timeout=20)]]'
kubectl get deployment -n fleetcast

kubectl exec -n fleetcast deployment/fleetcast-satellite-app-backend -- python -c 'import urllib.request,json; base="http://fleetcast-satellite-app-frontend"; paths=["/api/health","/api/dashboard","/api/station/GS-1"]; [(print(p,r.status, list(json.load(r).keys()))) for p in paths for r in [urllib.request.urlopen(base+p,timeout=20)]]'
kubectl get pods -n fleetcast
agent.summary:
Fixed a frontend routing issue: Nginx returned React HTML for `/api/*` requests instead of forwarding them to the backend.

Added a persistent Nginx ConfigMap and rolled out both frontend replicas. Verified health, dashboard, and station endpoints now return HTTP 200 with valid JSON through the frontend Service. All application replicas are ready.
